summary_of_bug: SimplexSolver can return a non-optimal solution that also violates constraints when solving maximization problems with equality constraints and non-negativity enabled. In the reported case it returns a feasible-looking value below the true optimum and leaves a GEQ constraint unsatisfied; the added test shows the same issue in a reduced form, where maximizing 0.2 x0 + 0.3 x1 subject to x0 + x1 = 23 should yield 6.9 but the solver does not.
